records.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one rehabilitation exercise step photograph, T-AXU-016 step 01 neutral quadruped. Reference images 1–3 define ONLY the same woman's exact identity, black ponytail, face, age, skin tone, natural build, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and dark charcoal long pants, photographic finish and pale gray-blue backdrop. Create one photorealistic landscape studio photograph. The same barefoot woman is on a medium gray rectangular non-slip exercise mat, head towards image LEFT, feet towards RIGHT. Camera is a slightly elevated oblique side/front view from HER RIGHT SIDE, the near-side arm is anatomically her RIGHT arm. Entire person, all two hands and two knees and bare feet visible with generous margin, natural proportions. She is in neutral four-point kneeling: both palms flat on the mat directly below shoulders, elbows comfortably straight, BOTH knees visibly touching the mat below hips, knees and hands separated naturally to reveal all four support points; thighs approximately vertical, shins resting on mat, backs of bare feet resting comfortably. Head and neck extend naturally from a neutral nearly horizontal back, gaze down slightly forward; pelvis square without rotation. Full hand contact and both knee contacts are clearly visible. Matte gray-blue seamless studio background and floor, soft studio light, subtle grounded shadows. No extra furniture, no shoes, no text, numbers, labels, motion arrows, icons, watermark, multiple views or collage. One single still pose. It is preparatory all-fours, do not lift either limb and do not hunch or arch her back. Output landscape 1536x1024.
records.visual_review: 通过：同参考女性、黑马尾、白T深灰裤、灰蓝柔光；头朝左，斜侧方近侧右侧，完整四肢入镜；双手肩下、双膝髋下均清楚接垫；中立背、自然头颈、人体比例合理，裸足双脚背贴垫；无文字箭头拼图。
records.review_method: 逐张生成后使用 view_image 查看，与行级姿势要求及前后帧一致性核对

records.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Make step 02 of the EXACT input quadruped photograph by extending ONLY the arm CLOSEST TO THE CAMERA, which is her RIGHT arm in this set. Identify the correct limb by its starting hand: the near-side palm whose fingertips are at the lower center of the frame, right in front of the near knee, NOT the farther palm towards the left middle of the mat. Lift that LOWER-CENTER near-side hand, bring its arm forward towards image LEFT with elbow comfortably straight, and keep this raised near-side right arm horizontal approximately level with the shoulder and no higher than her back. Its upper arm must emerge from the LARGE NEAR-SIDE WHITE SLEEVE prominently visible in the center of the image. The OTHER small far-side sleeve and far-side LEFT arm remain downward and the FAR-SIDE LEFT PALM stays flat touching the exact original mat position toward the left-middle of the mat. Leave BOTH knees touching the mat in the same places beneath hips. Keep both lower legs and feet completely unchanged on the mat; no leg raised. Preserve everything else pixel-location consistent: same woman face, ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal pants, bare feet, gray mat, gray-blue backdrop, lighting, framing, scale, oblique camera and all nonmoving support contacts. Do not lift the far-side arm. The final pose must clearly show the NEAR camera-side sleeve connected to the forward-raised arm, and the FAR sleeve connected to the vertical support arm. Natural neutral back and head orientation, no torso or pelvis rotation. Entire forward hand including fingertips fits frame with margin. Single image landscape 1536x1024; no words, arrows, numbers, symbols, watermark, collage.
records.visual_review: 通过：近相机侧右臂单独向前伸出、臂与背近水平且略低于肩；远侧左手仍原位贴垫，双膝双小腿双脚保持垫上接触，未抬腿；脸衣背景机位尺度与s01相符；姿态比例自然、全手脚完整，无文字箭头拼图。初稿错误伸远侧臂，定向返修后通过。

rejected_attempts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: rehabilitation T-AXU-016 step 02, SINGLE-ARM bird dog beginner version. Edit the input step 01 photograph. Preserve exactly the same woman identity, face, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt, charcoal long pants, barefoot appearance, gray mat, gray-blue studio setting, soft light, grounded shadows, oblique camera, landscape 1536x1024 framing, scale and mat positions. Her head remains toward image LEFT and feet RIGHT. The nearer arm to camera is HER anatomically RIGHT arm. Change only this RIGHT arm: lift the NEAR-SIDE right palm from the mat and extend that arm forward toward image LEFT, comfortably straight and horizontally at shoulder/body height (no higher than her back), with natural open hand, palm down. Her FAR-SIDE LEFT palm MUST remain firmly flat on the same mat position under her left shoulder and visible supporting her. BOTH knees MUST remain planted at exactly their original mat contacts beneath hips, BOTH shins and bare feet remain relaxed on mat, no leg moves or lifts. Natural neutral almost horizontal torso, chest and pelvis do not twist, head follows neutral neck, gaze slightly down. The finished photograph shows ONE arm extended in front, ONE left arm vertically supporting, and TWO knees visibly planted. Keep full hands/feet and extended fingertips within frame with margin. Do not raise any leg, do not create classic opposite-arm-and-leg bird-dog. Do not move camera, mat or body supports, do not change wardrobe or facial identity. No text, arrows, numbers, watermark or montage; one single photorealistic exercise pose.
rejected_attempts.visual_review: 返修：模型抬起远侧手臂，近侧手臂仍支撑，与本组近侧右臂前伸设定不一致。其余机位支点比例基本保持。

One landscape 1536x1024 full-body photograph, head toward image LEFT and bare feet RIGHT. Camera approximately side-on at a moderate low height, slightly 10–15 degrees oblique to separate both hands, knees and feet so BOTH sides' contacts remain visible. Woman on all fours on a gray non-slip exercise mat: BOTH palms spread flat directly beneath shoulders, elbows naturally straight, BOTH knees clearly contacting mat directly beneath hips, hips and knees at approximately right angles and back neutral almost horizontal. records.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: rehabilitation T-AXU-043 step 02, TINY knee hover hold. Edit the supplied step 01 photograph preserving its exact camera, composition, landscape 1536x1024 size, same woman's face and black ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt, charcoal long pants, bare feet, gray mat, gray-blue studio and soft light. Her head remains toward image LEFT. The ONLY movement is lift BOTH knees an extremely small distance, about 2 to 3 centimeters, above their previous contact points on the mat. Both knee centers remain vertically under the hips and keep about 90 degree knee angles; this is a very low bear-plank hover, not a crouch or downward dog. Show a narrow but clearly visible light/shadow AIR GAP directly under BOTH knees, between the bottom of the pants at each kneecap and the mat. Both palms remain planted at exactly the original positions beneath shoulders, all fingers flat and elbows naturally straight. Both flexed toes remain firmly planted at exactly the original positions, heels raised as in step 01. The shins now hover, never rest on the mat. Keep her back neutral almost horizontal, hips naturally at the same overall height as shoulder girdle, lift hip level only the few centimeters needed; no high-raised buttocks, no knee pulled up to chest. Chest and pelvis remain squared, no body rotation or forward shifting. Natural anatomy and stable proportions. Entire person, hands and feet stay fully in view with margins. Knee-to-mat gap must be legible at this camera angle. No words, arrows, labels, numbers, watermark, collage or second pose.
records.visual_review: 通过：双手及双脚趾在s01原支点持续接垫，两膝微离垫、两膝下方均见小间隙及阴影；膝仍髋下、背自然近水平、臀不高耸，不屈膝至胸；脸衣背景和机位尺度与s01一致，人体比例连续，全手脚与接触点可见；无文字箭头拼图。
